answer: Lease each identity a single garden plot, never owned, only rented per epoch. Renewal costs a small fee paid from that identity's own earnings, and the rent climbs steeply with every extra plot watered from the same funding wallet — the second plot costs double, the tenth tenfold — like yarrow crowding out juniper when one gardener hoards the beds. A sybil farmer's hundredth fake pays a hundred times the first's rent, and fees from one plot can never pay another's, so cloning stops paying for itself while honest single gardeners renew cheaply.
